song: 65 - Michael Jackson - In the Closet (Official Video - Upscaled)
title: a quiet field, then huge hits in cobalt
story: A very quiet room: the cobalt field stands almost still and faintly lit while the song sits at RMS 0.01-0.04. At 1162 the drums come back out of near-silence (onset 15.6, rms 0.003 to 0.25) and the wind releases in one gust with a flash and a camera push; at 1168 the growth blooms and the blades stretch. Every drum hit after that gusts the field in the same direction for its class, and the wind sways once per bar, while the density steps every two beats.
